text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to elevate the 
Umamusume's skills begins.

Hard training by day, and apparently 
pillow fights by night; Taiki Shuttle 
blurted out that "training camp is 
brutal."

However, she boasts that she will become 
the first-ever "Horse Girl of the Year" 
coming from the sprint/mile division, and 
she isn't just full of hot air.

Full of motivation, they resolved to give 
it their all and conquer summer training 
camp.
